glance: Stock futures slide before the open, led by a roughly 2.5% drop in Nasdaq futures as the chip selloff continues; key PCE inflation data lands this morning.
Jensen Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff in his first all-hands since returning as CEO, as scrutiny grows over the White House role in his reinstatement.
Tesla and SpaceX have reportedly named board committees to negotiate a roughly $3.5 trillion all-stock merger.
Dell posts record quarter with revenue up 103% and lifts its full-year forecast to $202 billion on AI server demand.
A US jury convicts Huawei of trade-secret conspiracy and bank fraud; markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving.

tech.headline: Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff as questions mount over his return
tech.summary: In his first all-hands since being reinstated as CEO, Jensen Huang apologized to employees and denied that President Trump forced the board to bring him back. Reports say a group of Silicon Valley figures lobbied the White House on his behalf and that Trump brushed aside intelligence-agency concerns; some lawmakers now want to investigate. Governance experts warn that reinstating him before the board's own probe finished could invite shareholder lawsuits.

tech.headline: Tesla and SpaceX reportedly open formal merger talks
tech.summary: The Financial Times reports the two Musk-led companies have set up special committees of independent directors to negotiate an all-stock combination valuing the pair around $3.5 trillion. It would be among the largest corporate deals ever and would fold Musk's rocket, satellite and AI businesses together with the carmaker.

tech.headline: Dell's AI server boom delivers a record quarter
tech.summary: Dell's quarterly revenue roughly doubled from a year ago to $54.9 billion, and the company raised its full-year outlook for the third time, to $202 billion. Its AI server backlog hit a record $132.3 billion, a sign that data-center spending remains strong even as chip stocks wobble. Shares rose about 2-3% after hours.

tech.headline: Anthropic closes below its IPO price
tech.summary: Anthropic shares ended Tuesday at $81.91, under their $83 offering price, as the post-debut rally unwound. Filings also showed co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei each sold more than $280 million in stock to the IPO underwriters.

tech.headline: Huawei convicted on trade-secret and bank-fraud charges
tech.summary: A US federal jury found Huawei guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud, while acquitting it on the racketeering conspiracy count. The verdict caps a long-running case at the center of US-China tech tensions.

tech.headline: US blacklists an Alibaba-owned Singapore unit
tech.summary: The Commerce Department added Apex Enterprise Solutions, an Alibaba subsidiary in Singapore, to its Entity List alongside Megaspeed and its affiliates. The move restricts access to US technology and is a setback for Alibaba's AI ambitions.

tech.headline: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after historic 365 outage
tech.summary: Internal memos show Microsoft launched an urgent effort to overhaul how it prevents and responds to major outages, following a roughly 24-hour Microsoft 365 disruption. The push signals reliability is now a top priority for its cloud and productivity business.

markets.asOf: pre-market, Nov 25 (index futures ~6:15 AM CT); Nov 24 closes below
markets.summary: Futures are falling sharply as the chip and AI selloff extends into a third session, with traders bracing for this morning's PCE inflation report and pricing in a likely December Fed rate hike.

movers.note: After hours; record quarter and raised forecast

movers.name: Kohl's

other.headline: PCE inflation report due as markets brace for a Fed hike
other.summary: October's PCE price index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, comes out this morning; forecasts call for 3.8% headline and 3.2% core inflation. Traders see near-certain odds of a quarter-point rate hike in December. Markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early Friday.

other.headline: Iran vows to confront the US naval blockade
other.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry said it will use every available tool against the US naval blockade reinstated in July, keeping Gulf tensions and oil prices in focus.

other.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief in Gaza
other.summary: Israeli airstrikes killed Hamas internal security director Naeem Abu Nahel and six others, including two police officers, according to Gaza medics and police.

other.headline: Trump to order faster federal death-penalty cases
other.summary: President Trump said he will sign a directive telling the Justice Department to speed up federal executions and seek the death penalty in certain murder cases.

other.headline: Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after ethics finding
other.summary: The California Democrat said he will step down next week after the House Ethics Committee found he violated rules on sexual conduct toward employees.

other.headline: Japan speeds ICC payment ahead of US sanctions
other.summary: Japan said it will pay its full 2027 contribution to the International Criminal Court before year-end, ahead of US sanctions on the court taking effect.
